title: 第6章 食气者神明不死第21章 邪魔胚胎秘境工作求月票
content_zh:
“好了！确认一下，在这里签个字就行！”
让陆羽签字确认之后，罗悦带着陆羽去管理局的后勤仓库领取管理局给地仙道修士配置的基础物资。
专门的手机，可以链接到帝国地仙管理局的内网。
陆羽把自己手机卡拔下，塞入新手机中，重新开机，就看见手机屏幕上熟悉的金红龙徽标志。
点开应用，里面有吹水聊天的论坛，各路大神在其中出没。
或是讨论修行，或是炫耀战绩，或是打着广告，十分热闹。
陆羽稍微看了一下，就在罗悦的指点中找到他刚才确认领取的功法和法术。
赤鸦炼日诀和赤阳心灯都在应用的藏经阁中，点开就能看见详细的图文内容。
从入门修炼，到精通入土，都在其中，不但有文字，还有配套的视频讲解，完全的傻瓜式教学。
下面还有评论区，有分享自己修炼经验的，还有免费教学，指导新人入门的。
修炼学习的氛围好到爆。
“你回去再翻吧。我要跟你说一下，接下来地仙管理局会给你安排工作。”
“只要你没有特殊要求，地仙管理局会按照就近原则，给你安排在龙舒城。”
“前期你修为弱，都不会给你安排什么涉及战斗的活，一般都是像我一样的文职工作，等你实力提升后，有一定的战斗自保能力后，才会让你进入到守卫龙舒城的危险工作中去！”
“按照现在的排队顺序，估计有个三四天，就会有工作安排发下来，到时候有不懂的可以在手机上问我！等你到了工作岗位上，也会有老人带你入门的！”
帝国的地仙管理局还是比较人性化的，不是黑社会修仙的路数，不会赶鸭子上架，浪费人力资源。
听罗悦这么一说，陆羽也安心了不少。
他现在还没学会法术，可没有本事去对付藏在帝国疆域中，藏在阴暗角落里的敌人。
忙完这些，又与罗悦聊了一会天，顺便在地仙管理局的食堂蹭了一顿午饭。
地仙管理局的食堂，比陆羽在家里做的伙食好多了。

菜肴精致，都是出自大厨之手，营养丰富，都是灵材，猛兽之肉烹饪的药膳。
吃进肚里，都让陆羽浑身暖烘烘的。
“这局里的饭菜就是好吃，以前要是能天天吃这等饭菜，我五十岁前肯定有把握踏入仙途！”
陆羽心中感慨。
好在他现在成了修士，以后每天也能凭借修士证在管理局的食堂里吃一顿这样的饭菜。
第二顿就要交钱，一顿饭一万块，这还是有帝国补贴后的价格。
在局外，这一顿饭菜起码十万起步。
吃完饭，陆羽与罗悦告别，骑着小电驴往家赶。
领到功法与法术，他已经迫不及待地想要回家修炼一番，体验一下成为地仙道修士的好处。
回到家。
陆母在家照顾弟弟，陆父出去吃饭去了，最近陆家的人听说陆羽踏入仙途，都在打听这事，频繁请陆父陆母吃饭，各种示好。
反正只要不打扰到他，陆羽一概不管。
如今牛逼，总得让父母广而告之，享受享受别人羡慕的目光，自豪一下。
不然锦衣夜行，陆羽岂不是白踏入仙途了。
陆家的快乐，就是如此朴实无华。
回到自己的房间里，陆羽掏出手机翻阅赤鸦炼日诀慢慢研究，学习。
content_en:
"Okay! Just confirm, just sign here!"
After asking Lu Yu to sign and confirm, Luo Yue took Lu Yu to the logistics warehouse of the administration to receive the basic supplies allocated by the administration for the Earth Immortal Dao monks.
A dedicated mobile phone can be linked to the intranet of the Imperial Earth Immortal Administration Bureau.
Lu Yu took out the SIM card from his phone, inserted it into his new phone, turned it on again, and saw the familiar gold and red dragon emblem on the phone screen.
Click on the app, and there is a forum for chatting with friends, where all kinds of great people appear.
They were discussing spiritual practice, showing off their achievements, or advertising, and it was very lively.
Lu Yu took a quick look and found the exercises and spells he had just confirmed to receive from Luo Yue's guidance.
The Red Crow Sun Refining Technique and the Red Yang Heart Lamp are both in the Sutra Pavilion where they are used. Click on them to see detailed pictures and texts.
From entry-level practice to mastery, it's all included. Not only does it have text, but it also has supporting video explanations, making it a complete fool-proof teaching.
There is also a comment area below, where some people share their own cultivation experiences, and there are also free tutorials to guide newbies in getting started.
The atmosphere for practicing and studying is so good.
"You go back and look through it again. I want to tell you that the Dixian Administration Bureau will arrange work for you next."
"As long as you have no special requirements, the Dixian Administration Bureau will arrange for you to stay in Longshu City in accordance with the principle of proximity."
"In the early stage, if your cultivation is weak, you will not be assigned any work involving combat. It will usually be a civilian job like mine. After your strength improves and you have a certain ability to protect yourself in combat, you will be allowed to enter the dangerous work of guarding Longshu City!"
"According to the current queuing order, it is estimated that within three or four days, work arrangements will be sent out. If you don't understand, you can ask me on the phone! When you get to the job, there will be an old man to help you get started!"
The empire's Earthly Immortal Management Bureau is still relatively humane. It is not a gangster way of cultivating immortals. It will not rush ducks to the shelves and waste human resources.
Hearing what Luo Yue said, Lu Yu felt relieved a lot.
He hasn't learned magic yet, but he doesn't have the ability to deal with enemies hiding in dark corners within the empire's borders.
After finishing these tasks, I chatted with Luo Yue for a while and had lunch in the canteen of the Dixian Administration Bureau.
The canteen in the Dixian Administration Bureau is much better than the food Lu Yu cooks at home.
The dishes are exquisite and made by master chefs. They are rich in nutrients and are made from spiritual materials, including the meat of wild beasts.
Lu Yu felt warm all over after eating it.
"The food here is delicious. If I could eat this kind of food every day, I would definitely be on the path to immortality before I turn fifty!"
Lu Yu sighed in his heart.
Fortunately, he has become a monk now, and he can eat one meal like this every day in the canteen of the Administration Bureau with his monk certificate.
You have to pay for the second meal, which is 10,000 yuan per meal. This is the price after the empire's subsidies.
Outside the office, this meal costs at least 100,000 yuan.
After dinner, Lu Yu said goodbye to Luo Yue and rode home on a small electric donkey.
After receiving the exercises and spells, he couldn't wait to go home to practice and experience the benefits of becoming an Earth Immortal monk.
Back home.
Lu's mother was taking care of her younger brother at home, and Lu's father had gone out to eat. Recently, people in the Lu family heard that Lu Yu had entered the path of immortality, and they were all asking about it. They frequently invited Lu's father and Lu's mother to dinner and showed their goodwill in various ways.
Anyway, as long as it doesn't disturb him, Lu Yu doesn't care.
Nowadays, if you are awesome, you have to let your parents spread the word, enjoy the envious eyes of others, and be proud of it.
Otherwise, Lu Yu's journey to immortality would have been in vain if he walked in brocade clothes at night.
The Lu family's happiness is so simple and unpretentious.
Back in his room, Lu Yu took out his mobile phone and flipped through the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique to slowly study and learn.
